answer: Rather than prove who you are, the network asks what you can still produce, on a seeded vertex that changes every epoch. Duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger, and a deterministic gate refuses text outside 120 to 600 characters, under twelve tokens, or above 55 percent repetition. Bulk filler fails automatically, removing the cheapest meadow a farm has: one phrase sent a thousand times. Scaling the ledge therefore means financing independent reasoning across every account, while the cap keeps the marginal account earning less than it costs. Seal 19r46.
